hook: He sent 40 quotes this month. 6 said yes.
cta_sub: AI follow-up that turns quotes into jobs

beats.say: Forty quotes sent this month. Six customers said yes.
The rest just went quiet. I don't have time to chase every one.
Ray, quiet doesn't mean no. Most of them just never heard from you again.
I'm Jarvis. A lot of sales happen after several follow ups, but most businesses stop after one. That's where your jobs are going.
The day after a quote, I text to see if they have questions. Three days later, I check in again. A week later, I offer the next open slot.
Not if it's helpful. I answer what they're unsure about, like how long the repair takes, or if they can wait for the car.
I book the drop off on your calendar and remind them the night before.
How many of this month's quotes could you bring back?
I already followed up on all thirty four. Five booked this week, and three want to talk Monday.
If your quotes keep going quiet, DM the word BUILD, and Jarvis Works will set me up for your shop.
